blurb: Guests board a fully enclosed, climate-controlled vessel for scenic cruises on Grand Traverse Bay. Cruises operate rain or shine with a focus on hospitality and environmental stewardship. Children under 2 ride free but must be included in reservations; children under 16 must be supervised by an adult.
extraNote: Tour ticket purchases are final; exchanges allowed if requested 48 hours prior · No refunds for no-shows or missed departures · Cruises operate rain or shine unless unsafe weather conditions · No outside food or beverage allowed; no outside alcohol allowed · Smoking and vaping prohibited onboard · Cannabis prohibited onboard under federal law · Discovery Pier, Traverse City, MI; parking across the street at Discovery Center Collaborative building · June through October
